recommendations.regimenLabel: Urgent plasma exchange + corticosteroid (± caplacizumab/rituximab) for TTP
steps: TTP: start PLASMA EXCHANGE immediately (don't wait for ADAMTS13) + corticosteroids; add caplacizumab/rituximab.
Do NOT transfuse platelets unless life-threatening bleeding (may worsen thrombosis).
HUS: supportive care, renal support; eculizumab for atypical/complement-mediated HUS.
Monitor LDH, platelets, haemoglobin and organ function.

drugRefs.duration: typically 3 days then taper per response
drugRefs.why: Immunosuppression alongside plasma exchange for immune-mediated TTP. Do NOT give platelet transfusions unless life-threatening bleeding.

drugRefs.freq: once daily (during and after plasma exchange per protocol)
drugRefs.why: Blocks platelet-VWF interaction, hastening platelet recovery and reducing refractoriness/exacerbations in acute immune TTP.
Reduces anti-ADAMTS13 autoantibody production in immune TTP; used for acute treatment and to prevent relapse.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Thrombotic Microangiopathies (TTP/HUS)

drugRefs.dose: 900 mg weekly ×4, then 1200 mg fortnightly (adult induction)
drugRefs.why: First-line for atypical/complement-mediated HUS. Requires meningococcal vaccination/prophylaxis before or at initiation.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Thrombotic Microangiopathies (TTP/HUS)

decision.label: Immediate plasma exchange + steroid (TTP); eculizumab for aHUS

confirm: Microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia + thrombocytopenia (± renal failure, neuro signs, fever). Schistocytes on film; ADAMTS13 in TTP.
